name: web-ui-craft
description: Hard-won UI techniques for building or reworking browser apps, especially single-file HTML/JS apps, PWAs, dashboards, media players, map apps and browser games. Covers screen-real-estate-first layouts, sheets/modals driven by browser history (Back closes the top one), press-on-release input with press quarantine across mouse, touch, keyboard and gamepad, older-eyes accessibility, light/dark theming (including third-party widgets like Leaflet), big pooled lists, photo carousels and a full-screen
